thesis.title: Thesis Simulation
thesis.subtitle: Multi-reader warehouse. Inventory runs will load this saved scene later.
thesis.emptyCanvas: Create a section in the sidebar, then place devices and stations. Turn selected stations into readers.
thesis.radarOverlap: Centers are within two radii, so the ranges can overlap.
thesis.radarGap: Spacing is larger than two radii, so the ranges can leave gaps.
thesis.bulkHint: This section is initializing. Add devices and stations, turn some stations into readers, then Save to mark it initialized.
thesis.bulkLocked: This section is initialized. Edit or place one node at a time. Bulk generate stays off.
thesis.clearDevicesConfirm: Remove every device from this section? This cannot be undone.
thesis.clearInfraConfirm: Remove every station and reader from this section? This cannot be undone.
thesis.discardConfirm: This section is not saved. Discard it?
thesis.deleteSectionBody: Delete "{{name}}" and everything placed in it? This cannot be undone.

errors.network: Cannot reach the thesis service. Start PostgreSQL and the backend.
errors.outside_bounds: That change would leave a node outside the warehouse.
errors.device_kind_locked: A device stays a device. A station and a reader can be converted into each other.
errors.subtype_not_used: Stations and readers do not use a device type.
errors.not_found: That section or node is no longer in the database.
errors.empty_name: Give the section a name before saving.
errors.too_many: That is too many nodes for one action.
errors.bad_param: Check the numbers in this card.
errors.bad_size: Length and width must be between 0 and 10000 m.
errors.bad_count: Enter a whole number of nodes.
errors.bulk_locked: Bulk generate is off after the section is saved.
errors.grid_empty: That spacing does not fit a station in this warehouse.
